name: hush
description: The hush plugin for Claude Code. hush is self-hosted in-app feedback and anonymous usage tracking for Expo, React Native and web apps, native iOS apps and Godot games.

plugins.name: hush
plugins.description: Installs and wires @bavrk/hush in an Expo, React Native, web or Capacitor app, and plans the events, funnels and conversion values it tracks.
